scope: Functional explicit image -> owned auxiliary DMA -> actual statistics; original C1.70 GUI boundary remains unresolved
implementation: accompanying cmos.c, z7ii.c and native fixture changes
notation: addresses, masks and sample words hexadecimal; dimensions, input intensities, counters and host durations decimal
model_changes: An explicit image path binds without fixture-provider; invalid input cannot fall back to fixture bytes.
Consume one raster separator, including CRLF; retain leading raster whitespace/# as pixels.
Retain a loaded scene until image property reassignment; active reassignment rejects.
Nearest-neighbor scene sampling uses the configured sensor coordinate system after guest crop/scale.
C170 requires LE16 grayscale: PGM v*257; PPM ((77R+150G+29B+128)>>8)*257.
No new request, IRQ, event, firmware modification, memory aperture or display enable.

native.red: Baseline image-source case fails: image configured, fixture-provider false, provider-bound incorrectly false.
native.additional_crop_check: PASS: final image-source case adds sensor4x4 / scene2x2 / cropped output2x2 with padded rows; same implementation
native.pixel_to_statistics_case: 2x2 PPM red/green/blue/white ->128x2 actual LE16 DMA; compare every sample, all four statistics scalars, one statistics DMA output and raw3.bit5 completion
native.coverage: binding/removal, active replacement rejection, immutable loaded file, explicit reload failure, raster whitespace and CRLF, malformed/truncated/missing input with fixture enabled, unsupported C170 sample width, crop coordinates and padding; existing reset/cancel/stale/input-boundary cases also pass
native.excluded_trials: initial -p filter omitted /arm and selected no case; two image-gray fixture revisions used geometry below the existing256-byte readout minimum; a negative-fixture assertion needed an unsigned cast. None is a passing device receipt.

original_input.other_inputs: existing TEMP3 descriptor17, descriptor18, empty descriptor12, acceleration(0,0,1024), RNG0, healthy paced UART battery, held F4
original_input.execution: five CPUs, MTTCG; cpu,nochain filtered logging
original_input.debugger: read-only final snapshot; no in-transaction pause or software-state injection

buffer_reads.address_domain: CPU0 MAS VA; requested DMA PA has the same numeric base; no new page-table comparison claimed

scene_trace.meaning: stable usable auxiliary samples do not alone supply the missing front-end/calculation join; absence does not establish global unreachability

limits: This repairs the existing explicit auxiliary image contract. It does not implement front-end unit1/2, group payload processing, paired parameter results, a physical sensor, normal GUI output, complete boot or full runtime stability. Different-duration counters are not physical rates.
